definition: near tie: top-two first-token letter logprob gap < 0.13 nats in replicate A or in B (src/r2_analysis.py::gaps); the logprobs lie on a ~0.125-nat grid
majority_rule: near-tie cell set to the majority correctness over its 4 rotations; 2-2 ties unchanged
letter_preference: pi fixed at the replicate-A estimate (a model property); the IRT part is refitted

2pl_post.notes: project 2PL: theta_m fixed effects, (log a_i, b_i) normal random effects integrated (marginal ML over questions, 41 x 401 grid); question-matched posterior draws

3pl_post.notes: 3PL with c = 0.25 (P = 0.25 + 0.75 sigma(a_i (theta_m - b_i))), project MML; posterior draws

letter_post.notes: letter-aware know-or-guess: P = pi_m(g) + (1 - pi_m(g)) sigma(a_i (theta_m - b_i)), g = shown gold letter, pi_m = model m's letter preference (4-rotation moment estimate); project MML

kg_letter4.notes: know-or-guess fitted on all 4 rotations (composite MML with pi_m letter preference); know once per cell, guess per rotation from pi_m; derived matrix
